page: Amazon Web Services c9g.16xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance powered by custom AWS Graviton processors. Built on the arm64 architecture, this instance features 64 dedicated physical cores running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz with a single thread per core. The hardware configuration includes 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

The c9g.16xlarge instance operates on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, which offloads virtualization functions to dedicated hardware to maximize CPU allocation to the guest operating system. This instance does not include local NVMe storage or bundled GPUs. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 34 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers.

Utilizing ARM-based Graviton processors yields high power efficiency and a favorable performance-per-resource profile compared to traditional x86 architectures. This instance is designed for compute-intensive workloads that benefit from dedicated physical cores and high clock speeds, such as high-performance computing, batch processing, media encoding, scientific modeling, and distributed analytics.
